title: Thai Khanom with Apricot Glaze
description: A sweet and savory Thai dessert featuring khanom and apricot glaze. This recipe is perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Pungent
ingredients.notes: Pungent herbs like cilantro or scallions

instructions: 2. Slice the dried apricots and mix with honey.
3. Place the khanom on a baking sheet and brush with coconut oil.
4. Bake the khanom for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
5. In a separate pan, heat the chopped pungent herbs over low heat.
6. Remove the khanom from the oven and drizzle with apricot glaze.
7. Garnish with additional chopped pungent herbs if desired.
